text:
Jorge L: Customer (FinPay BR) POC asks: all BR customer data served from sa-east1, BYOK keys in BR KMS, allowed DR failover to Canada (northamerica-northeast1) only for outages. Also asked: do any logs leave BR and how does egress charging work?

Tina R: Theyre planning Dedicated POC ~8-12 req/s, ~60k tokens/day, 1 month. We need: 1) short pricing one-pager with strict vs soft pin delta + egress buffer, 2) BYOK contract paragraph, 3) region subproc list for BR/CA.

Mikhail P: quick answers: tenant-pin on Dedicated supports strict pin (compute+storage+logs in-region). BYOK: customer must provision HSM-backed key in sa-east1 and sign BYOK addendum. Cross-region failover will incur cloud inter-region egress; we surface that as separate line item. Logs: if strict_pin enabled, request/audit logs remain in-region; aggregated telemetry may be replicated unless contract forbids.

Mikhail P: sample minimal routing policy snippet:
```yaml
routing_mode: strict_pin
primary: sa-east1
failover_on: outage
failover_target: northamerica-northeast1
kms_byok: true
log_retention: in_region
```

legal-bot: BYOK addendum needed: key custody clause, rotation & revocation process, zeroization at termination, and statement about possible egress charges on failover. I can draft a paragraph.

infra-oncall: quick region health check (staging):
curl -s -I https://staging.sa-east1.redwood.ai/health | head -n1
curl -s -I https://staging.northamerica-northeast1.redwood.ai/health | head -n1

Tina R: Can someone own the one-pager + subproc extract? Need by EOD tomorrow to prep call.

Mikhail P: Ill draft the one-pager with strict vs soft cost delta and sample egress calc.

legal-bot: Ill draft the BYOK paragraph and a residency clause for the SQ.

Jorge L: thanks all. Scheduling a 30m call with the customer Fri 11:00 BRT. Will post invite when doc drafts are up. :thumbsup:
